# TaleTrek

> Every story is a journey.

Free, open-source reading companion by l1br3. Turn any ebook (PDF, EPUB, MOBI, TXT) into an audiobook with on-device neural text-to-speech (Piper). Progressive Web App — no cloud, no subscription.

## Docs

- [Vision](https://github.com/l1br3/taletrek/blob/master/docs/VISION.md)
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/l1br3/taletrek/blob/master/docs/ROADMAP.md)
- [M0 Foundation PRD](https://github.com/l1br3/taletrek/blob/master/docs/prds/M0-foundation.md)
